# Inventory: Get Transfer Lots for Multiple Transactions

Area overview and notes: [inventory.md](../inventory.md)

`GET /transfer-lots/transactions` · tenant-scoped token

Get the Transfer Lots for multiple transactions at once. Allows fetching transfer lots for up to 25 deposit or withdraw transactions in a single request. All requested transactions must belong to the same account specified by the account_id parameter.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_transaction_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. You can include up to 25 instances of this parameter to fetch transfer lots for multiple transactions. |
| `account_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |

**Response 200**: Get Transfer Lots response for multiple transactions

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array of object | No | Array of Transfer Lots data, one for each requested transaction. |
| `data[].transaction_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |
| `data[].transaction_type` | string | Yes | Type of the transaction. A transfer-in transaction is "deposit"; a transfer-out transaction is "withdraw". One of: `deposit`, `withdraw`. |
| `data[].effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 timestamp representing the date from which the user-entered cost basis information is applied. Only present if explicitly set by the user. |
| `data[].transfer_lots` | array of object | No | List of transfer lots associated with the transaction. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Amount of the asset being transferred. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Nullable. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].acquisition_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lot was acquired. Nullable. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].client_acquisition_transaction_id` | string | No | The customer transaction ID that (if applicable) added the original lot to inventory. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].created_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transfer lot record was created. |
| `data[].transfer_lots[].modified_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transfer lot was modified. |
| `calculation_status` | string | No | Indicates the status of data calculations. Can be 'in_progress' when data may be incomplete due to ongoing calculations, or 'complete' when calculations have finished. One of: `in_progress`, `complete`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request - Returns if ANY transaction in the request has invalid data or parameters · 401 Unauthorized · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found - Returns if ANY transaction in the request cannot be found · 429 Too Many Requests
